name: Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU)
tests: SAT minimum 1190 (new SAT) for US-pattern applicants; AP grade 3 in two subjects. English: TOEFL iBT 79 or IELTS Academic 6.0 (from 2027 entry the test must be taken on or after 1 Sept 2025), or SAT EBRW 590.

name: United Arab Emirates University (UAEU)
tests: International applicants: Grade 12 average of 90% (health sciences, engineering, computing/AI, science, agriculture/veterinary) or 85% (business, humanities, education, law); English 90% in MOE Grade 12 English, or IELTS Academic 5.5, TOEFL iBT 70 or TOEFL ITP 525. Applicants must be 35 or younger. The MD programme is limited to nationals and funded students.
gpa_note: International applicants need a 90% (STEM and health) or 85% (other colleges) high-school average.

name: Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU)
tests: No SAT/ACT. Most bachelor's programmes are taught in German and require proof of German proficiency (e.g. DSH-2/TestDaF level). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access need the Studienkolleg and its assessment test (Feststellungsprüfung). Medicine and some programmes are restricted.
gpa_note: Foreign grades are converted with the Bavarian formula; restricted programmes select by grade.

name: University College Cork
tests: SAT/ACT not specified; A-level and IB minimums are published per programme. English: IELTS, TOEFL, Pearson PTE, Cambridge or Duolingo accepted, from a single sitting and valid within two years of course start (minimums listed on UCC’s English comparison page).
gpa_note: Programme-specific A-level grades and IB points (UCC publishes minimums and competitiveness bands each year).

name: Indian Institute of Science (IISc) Bangalore
tests: No SAT/ACT. Admission to the B.S. (Research) and B.Tech (Mathematics and Computing) uses national entrance exam ranks (JEE Main/Advanced, IISER Aptitude Test or NEET as specified each year). Teaching is in English.
gpa_note: Selection by national entrance exam rank; extremely competitive.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (IITK)
tests: No SAT/ACT. B.Tech/B.S. admission at every IIT is through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA seat allocation. Foreign nationals (and OCI/PIO cardholders from 4 March 2021 who opt for it) do NOT need JEE (Main) and may register for JEE (Advanced) directly; they compete for supernumerary foreign-national seats. Teaching is in English; no IELTS/TOEFL is required.
gpa_note: Admission is by JEE (Advanced) rank; foreign-national seats are allotted on merit among foreign candidates.

name: American University of Beirut (AUB)
tests: SAT or ACT required for most applicants. English: TOEFL / IELTS or AUB English requirements (see Admissions English Requirements page).

name: University of Twente
tests: No SAT/ACT. English: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 per section (IELTS Online, One Skill Retake and Indicator not accepted), or TOEFL iBT 90 with at least 21 per section (MyBest not accepted). Programme-specific maths/physics requirements apply; some programmes have selection or mandatory matching activities.
gpa_note: Diploma comparable to Dutch VWO with required maths (and physics for engineering).

name: University of Gothenburg
tests: No SAT/ACT. Swedish-taught programmes require Swedish 3; English-taught programmes require English 6 (typically IELTS Academic 6.5 with no section below 5.5, or TOEFL iBT 90 with writing 20). Programme-specific maths/science prerequisites apply.
gpa_note: Selection mainly by upper-secondary grades (merit rating) when programmes are oversubscribed.
strengths: Business (School of Business, Economics and Law)

name: University of Florida
tests: SAT, ACT or CLT required for all first-year applicants (Florida Board of Governors rule 6.002), superscored. International applicants must show English proficiency (see UF international page).

name: University of Ottawa
tests: SAT/ACT not required. Proof of English or French proficiency depending on the language of the programme (see uOttawa admission requirements).

name: University of Strathclyde
tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English requirements are set by country on Strathclyde’s international entry requirements pages.
gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. Economics: ABB–BBB, or IB 32–30 with no subject below 5.

name: University of Tübingen
tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.
gpa_note: Open-admission programmes accept all qualified applicants; restricted (NC) programmes rank by converted school grade.

name: University of Lausanne
tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught in French; non-francophone applicants must prove French proficiency or pass UNIL's French exam. Foreign diplomas must meet Swiss recognition criteria. Medicine requires the Swiss aptitude test.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: Tianjin University
tests: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/
gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

name: Beijing Normal University
tests: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/
gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

name: Victoria University of Wellington
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general. English: IELTS Academic 6.0 with no band below 5.5 (IELTS Online and One Skill Retake accepted); TOEFL iBT 80 (Home Edition accepted); Duolingo 105 with no band below 95; PTE also accepted.
gpa_note: Entry by secondary qualification equivalent to NZ University Entrance; limited-entry programmes (e.g. architecture) are selective.

name: Beijing Institute of Technology
tests: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/
gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

name: University of Freiburg
tests: No SAT/ACT. A high level of German is required for most undergraduate programmes (accepted certificates listed by the university). Applicants without direct university access attend a Studienkolleg. Medicine/dentistry/pharmacy are highly competitive.
gpa_note: Restricted programmes select by converted school grade; medicine requires near-top grades.

name: University of Surrey
tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: e.g. Economics IELTS Academic 6.5 with 6.0 in writing and 5.5 in other elements.
gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. Economics: AAB (ABB with A-level Maths/Economics), or IB 34 (33 with HL Maths/Economics).

name: University of Calgary
tests: SAT/ACT not required. English proficiency required for applicants whose first language is not English (see UCalgary admission requirements).

name: Technical University of Darmstadt
tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.
gpa_note: Open-admission programmes accept all qualified applicants; restricted (NC) programmes rank by converted school grade.

name: University of Rochester
tests: Test-optional (no disadvantage for not submitting, also for scholarships). Admitted fall 2026: SAT EBRW 700-760, SAT Math 730-790, ACT 31-35; 34% admitted without tests. English exam results (or a waiver request) required for non-native speakers.
gpa_note: Admitted students fall 2026: SAT EBRW 700-760, Math 730-790, ACT 31-35; enrolled average recalculated GPA 3.77.

name: University of California, Irvine (UC Irvine)
tests: Test-blind: SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission. English (if required): IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before Jan 2026) / 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale (from Jan 2026). Some majors or campuses may expect more.

name: University of Maryland, College Park
tests: Test-optional through the fall 2027 cycle. English: TOEFL iBT 95 (0-120 scale) or 5 (new 1-6 scale), IELTS 7, Duolingo 120; lower scores may be referred to the Maryland English Institute.

name: Maastricht University
tests: No SAT/ACT. English-taught programmes require English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL/Cambridge as specified per programme); some programmes need maths at a set level. Selective and fixus programmes add a selection procedure.
gpa_note: Diploma equivalent to Dutch VWO with required subjects; selective programmes assess grades and motivation.

name: University of Minnesota Twin Cities
tests: Test optional: freshman applicants through fall 2027 are not required to submit ACT or SAT scores. Non-native English speakers must provide English proficiency evidence (TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo or equivalent).
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: University of Canterbury | Te Whare Wānanga o Waitaha
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification. English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL/other) required for non-native speakers at the level set for each degree.
gpa_note: Entry equivalent to NZ University Entrance; engineering requires strong maths and physics.

name: American University of Sharjah (AUS)
tests: Maths placement via EmSAT, SAT/ACT or AUS placement for some programmes. English: IELTS / TOEFL / EmSAT English (programme minimums apply).

name: Sun Yat-sen University

Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/
gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.
